_comment: DEMO EXAMPLE under scaffold/. To sample your own published data sources, copy this to datasources.json at the PROJECT ROOT and fill in .env (copy scaffold/.env.example) with your Tableau connection. tableau-data prefers the root file over this example. One entry per source; (ds_name + project_name) identify it uniquely on the site. VizQL Data Service queries PUBLISHED data sources only -- not embedded -- and needs Tableau Cloud or Server 2025.1+. For an embedded source or a database, export it to CSV from Tableau and drop the CSV(s) in data/ instead (each CSV = one data source). Per-datasource credentials are not handled yet. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
